components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA button (e.g. 'Book a service'), large size for 44px touch target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00375B; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 24px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 6px; border: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #00536C; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00375B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost/outline button for secondary CTAs (e.g. 'Browse services').
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #0B121A; padding: 12px 24px; min-height: 44px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #E0E5EB; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #00375B; color: #00375B; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00375B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Catalog service card, flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html:
Deep Cleaning

components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #F3F4F6; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-img { width: 100%; height: 160px; object-fit: cover; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; color: #1A1416; margin: 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 14px; color: #736469; margin: 4px 0 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: 44px-tall header/drawer nav item, active state uses the primary token.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 16px; color: #006477; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #00375B; background: #F7F9FA; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #00375B; background: #E7F4F9; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Teal confirmation/status pill, white text for readable contrast on the saturated fill.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #006477; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; }

narrative.overview:
Nuqaa Asir reads as a real, organized operation: clean, competent, and unfussy. The system uses a deep Nuqaa Navy (#00375B) drawn from the logo, a restrained Teal (#006477) for supporting interactions, and a pale blue tint (#E7F4F9) for selected states. Red remains semantic and is reserved for errors or destructive actions.

Quiet surfaces let navy, teal, and clear typographic hierarchy carry the brand without discount clutter or crowded marketplace styling.
keyCharacteristics: Deep Nuqaa Navy primary aligned with the logo
Pure white surfaces; brand lives in primary + accent + typography, not background tint
Flat by default; elevation is a hover response, not a resting state
Generous 44px minimum touch targets throughout (Customer and Admin alike)
Fully bilingual, RTL-mirrored — logical spacing and alignment, never hardcoded left/right

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Navy carries primary actions and active states; teal supports links and secondary interactions. Pale blue is reserved for selection and focus.

rules.name: The Semantic Red Rule
rules.body: Wine, pink, and warm red are not brand navigation colors. Red is reserved for errors, destructive actions, and urgent states.

rules.name: The One System Stack Rule
rules.body: Every weight and size comes from the same font stack. The navy/teal palette and spacing carry the brand voice.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat. Shadow is earned by interaction (hover, focus), never applied decoratively to a static card or section.

rules.name: The 44px Rule
rules.body: Every tappable element — nav link, button, drawer toggle, logout — is at least 44×44px. Non-negotiable across both Customer and Admin, not just "large" screens.

dos: Do use Nuqaa Navy (#00375B) for primary actions and active navigation, with Navy Tint (#E7F4F9) for selected backgrounds.
Do use Teal (#006477) for links and supporting interactions.
Do size every interactive element to at least 44×44px (The 44px Rule) — this is a bilingual, cross-generation customer base, not a power-user tool.
Do mirror all spacing, icons, and Drawer placement per reading direction (RTL for Arabic, the default locale) — logical properties, never hardcoded left/right.
Do keep cards flat at rest; reserve shadow for hover/interaction (The Flat-By-Default Rule).
donts: Don't build discount-banner clutter, stock icons, or crowded undifferentiated listings — the explicit "generic gig-economy app" anti-reference from PRODUCT.md.
Don't use wine, pink, or warm red for brand navigation or primary actions; reserve red for semantic danger and error states.
Don't introduce a second display typeface for "personality." One system stack, carried by size/weight/color.
Don't substitute Ant Design's default bright blue (#1677ff) for the darker Nuqaa Navy.
Don't apply resting shadows to static cards or sections — elevation is earned by hover, not decoration.
